findings.title: F1 audit belum selesai menurut source of truth
findings.closureRequirement: Regenerate F1 audit from latest source and make it the only current completeness baseline.

findings.title: Audit F1 lama kontradiktif dengan datanya sendiri
findings.closureRequirement: Replace contradictory HIDDEN/API-only counts with generated current-source classifications.

findings.title: Tidak ada work item aktif pada snapshot
findings.closureRequirement: Keep one explicit recovery work item active and make dependent UI work BLOCKED until its prerequisites close.

findings.title: Mayoritas regression adalah source-contract, bukan eksekusi bisnis
findings.closureRequirement: Separate source-contract tests from runtime evidence; critical/high findings require runtime evidence before closure.

findings.title: Critical UAT coverage hanya memetakan skenario ke file
findings.closureRequirement: Critical UAT coverage must execute/reference scenario evidence, not only test filenames.

findings.title: Browser UAT resmi sengaja read-only
findings.closureRequirement: Expand browser UAT from read-only checks to safe mutation journeys in R8.

findings.title: Tidak ada Company/Tenant administration CRUD

findings.title: Tidak ada branch switcher operasional di Admin

findings.title: User/role API lebih lengkap daripada UI

findings.title: WorkShift ada di database tetapi tidak punya workflow runtime

findings.title: Information architecture terlalu menggabungkan domain besar

findings.title: Dokumen status saling bertentangan
findings.closureRequirement: Reconcile contradictory status docs into one current recovery truth.

findings.title: F1 audit lama sudah stale
findings.closureRequirement: Regenerate F1/recovery audit after each material wave and prevent stale counts in CI.

closureRules: A finding cannot close from source/regex evidence alone when runtimeEvidenceRequired=true.
Operator-facing capability requires discoverable menu/route/form/action and failure/empty/success states.
Tenant identity must come from trusted context; branch/warehouse scope and permission must be tested.
Retriable mutations require idempotency where applicable.
Human Stage-20 remains separate and cannot auto-pass.
R7 final UI closure is blocked until R1-R6 functional prerequisites are stable.
R8 final evidence must bind one exact commit/source fingerprint/build artifact.
